mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate above 5% indicates tightening monetary policy, compressing S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances with UNRATE < 4% and PAYEMS growth > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly RSAFS increase above $400,000 signals strong consumer spending, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of months with RSAFS increase > $400,000.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL are both increasing, the combined effect predicts negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened inflation concerns.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 55% of instances with both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL increasing.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the current UNRATE level, as a standalone indicator, predicts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, with lower rates associated with positive returns.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns do not show a significant negative correlation with UNRATE levels (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A HOUST increase above 1,700 units signals a strong housing market, predicting positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during mid-cycle expansions.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of mid-cycle expansion months with HOUST > 1,700.
